summary_en: 300,000 shares (0.37% of S/O); ¥270.0M upper limit; open-market purchase on TSE; execution window 1–31 July 2026. Purpose: acquisition for restricted-stock grant programmes for executives and employees.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to the by-law provision under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Asanuma Corporation's board of directors resolved on 25 June 2026 to acquire up to 300,000 treasury shares (0.37% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, computed as 300,000 ÷ 80,726,816) for a maximum total of ¥270.0 million. The shares are common stock of the company, acquired via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period 1–31 July 2026. The stated purpose is to support two equity incentive programmes: a restricted-stock grant scheme for executives and an equivalent scheme for employees. The company notes that these programmes aim to provide incentives for sustained corporate-value enhancement and to deepen value-sharing with shareholders. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 59,474 treasury shares.
